机制概述: Amon has 4 Danger Level Forms that upgrade as he takes damage each beat. Each gives him increasing benefits.

效果.效果: Setup: Activate Code White (Lvl 0). Your other Danger Levels are inactive.
Only one Danger Level can be active at a time. Deactivate any older Danger Level when activating a new one.

<g-b>End:</g-b> Raise your Danger Level by activating the next one in this sequence (<i-sb>White</i-sb> → <i-sb>Green</i-sb> → <i-sb>Yellow</i-sb> → <i-sb>Red</i-sb>) if you took any damage. Otherwise, lower your Danger Level by activating the next one in this sequence (<i-sb>Red</i-sb> → <i-sb>Yellow</i-sb> → <i-sb>Green</i-sb> → <i-sb>White</i-sb>).
